render-strip kit adoption - real render, demo data

Home - Musina FM

Not hand-drawn. Both frames are the actual Radio home - RadioPage with its record player, station strip and now-playing bar - rendered headlessly to PNG at 390 x 844 logical px / dpr 3, with every numbered point placed from the widget's measured rect.

Numbered points are measured from the widget tree, not placed by hand. Numbers are global and never re-used.

Shipped - what main renders today

note - how these renders were produced

A widget-test harness (test/render/render_screen_test.dart); no app code touched. It pumps the real RadioPage inside the app's own theme pair at one phone screen (390 x 844): the page is a full-screen player laid out against the viewport, so there is no longer content to fit.

Stations come from radio_sdk's demo data (DemoSession active, RadioSdkDependencies registered as main.dart does). The only stand-in is the audio player: a widget test has no audio_service host, so a silent RadioAudioEngine is bound through the SDK's own GetIt seam. Nothing plays; everything drawn is the app's.

Light and dark frames look alike on purpose: Radio's home draws its own liquid background rather than the theme surface.
